name: YPF Sociedad Anonima

ads_ratio.source: YPF Form 20-F, Item 9 (Shares and ADSs) and the Amended and Restated Deposit Agreement dated March 9, 2022 filed with the 20-F: each ADS represents one Class D share
ads_ratio.reason: The FY2025 20-F's filed share counts (393,312,793 shares) are on the pre-split basis in force when the annual filing was made, when 1 ADS = 1 Class D share. The 10-for-1 share split effective August 4, 2026 (company Form 6-K filed 2026-07-21) moved the ratio to 10 post-split Class D shares per ADS with no change in ADSs outstanding — economically identical to 1 pre-split share per ADS, the basis of every per-share figure in this run. Ratio 1.0 therefore leaves the filed per-share figures correctly comparable to the $51.11 ADS price; applying 10 would double-count the split.

fx_conversion.source: frankfurter.app — ECB reference rates (closest business day to each period end)

fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 9 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
OE_VOLATILE: OE/share range over the last 5 yrs spans >3x — normalized base helps but the business is cyclical; widen bear weight
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2024, 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base

FX_CONVERTED: reporting currency ARS converted to USD at period-end ECB reference rates (frankfurter.app) — flow facts use the period-end rate, not a period average; the rates used are recorded in dcf_numbers.json fx_conversion
USD_TRANSLATIONS_USED: the issuer files its own USD convenience translations alongside its reporting currency; the engine used the filed USD figures

ADS_RATIO_APPLIED: 20-F filer — per-share figures scaled x1.0 ordinary shares per ADS (YPF Form 20-F, Item 9 (Shares and ADSs) and the Amended and Restated Deposit Agreement dated March 9, 2022 filed with the 20-F: each ADS represents one Class D share) so they are comparable to the ADS price; TTM pins are taken as per-ADS already
BASE_DIVERGENCE: latest FY OE/share -0.34 vs 3-yr median 0.60 — one of them is distorted; find out which and why
LOW_OE_YIELD: base OE yield 1.2% — valuation rests almost entirely on growth; tier is fragile
HIGH_NET_DEBT: net debt is 30.8x normalized OE — levered OE can vanish fast; stress the bear cases
